Questioner: 
The first question is on exports. We are seeing a sharp increase in exports over the last one year. 
Now with this geopolitical tensions again starting to shape up, what is the outlook for exports?

opportunities that we are targeting over the period?

Currently on exports, our mix is like 50% is to Europe intercompany partners and 25% is 
Southeast Asia, and the remaining is China and Americas. So, this is how is the spread and this

were a lot dependent only on Europe and lately in the last two years, we have developed into 
other markets.

we utilize that. If there is a good demand, we leverage, we do 21 shifts, we do some efficiency

demand from outside India.

line, that is the denominator, is increasing. The domestic market is growing at 14% to 15% for 
us, so with this higher base at the local market, we expect that export will continue to be between 
15% and 20%.
